summary: This tutorial introduces LibreOffice Impress, a free and open-source presentation software. It covers installation on GNU/Linux using the Synaptic Package Manager and downloading the LibreOffice suite. Key features include various toolbars such as Title bars, Menu bars, Standard bars, Formatting bars, and Status bars. The tutorial demonstrates creating a new presentation by selecting templates, choosing a slide design, and customizing it with text and images. Users can save presentations in the Impress document format (ODP) and open them later. Additionally, it explains how to save LibreOffice Impress presentations as Microsoft PowerPoint files for compatibility. The tutorial also touches on managing the LibreOffice suite and using Impress for creating professional presentations.
